answer: Session keys rotate every 6 epochs, and a new key is released only after 3 confirmations from unrelated auditors, so an idle identity holds a dead key and cannot sign. Numbers: 1 seeded account needs 3 distinct confirmers, 1,000 accounts need 3,000, and a 200-seat rotating pool means a farm must own 15 panels to hold a majority. Cost per fake: 3 bribes plus a wasted tundra epoch. A vine grafted onto its own knoll is cut at rotation.
